Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class HealthcareAiCompanyAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.HealthcareAiCompanyAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
HealthcareAiCompanyPort
@Component public class HealthcareAiCompanyAdapter extends Object implements HealthcareAiCompanyPort
JPA adapter implementing HealthcareAiCompanyPort for persisting and querying AI healthcare company records.

Source URLs and validation sources are stored as pipe-delimited strings in the database and converted to/from List<String> on the domain side.
